about_the_game:
Stock all of the shops with the reagents and tools your magicians and alchemists could dream of with the KR Fantasy Market - Magic Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with a set of MV/MZ-sized tiles to add that extra layer of detail to your store maps that you’ve been dreaming of! A2, A4, and 1 B sheet offers warm wood and stone floors and walls to give your shops basic rooms, as well as counters, windows, and rugs to add a cozier vibe to the space. Keep your heroes from seeing the best items on sale by having those stored safely in the basement or on the second floor which can only be reached by using the stairs with the shopkeeper’s permission.

But the real highlight of this pack are the 5 B sheets filled with useful objects for your heroes to purchase! With spellbooks, maps, crystals, keys, accessories, potions, and more to choose from, you’re sure to be able to fill all of your shops with interesting items for sale. Help your players easily tell what a shopkeeper sells by placing bottles of health potions and bags of herbs on their table, or let your players wander between a shop’s tables and purchase the exact mystery box they want by interacting with it on the map! Have your heroes pick up new wizard robes or statues that boost their stats when placed in their home, or use this pack’s crystals or lit lanterns as markers so your players can easily tell how many dungeons they’ve completed. Add some on-map options for shopping or just give all of your mages’ rooms a visual upgrade with the KR Fantasy Market - Magic Tileset!



The Fantasy Market ~ Magic Tileset Includes:

* Ground tiles (from Everyday Town):
* Cement, flat dirt, cobblestone, 4 colors of wood flooring in 2 directions, 4 colors of rugs (several shapes and styles) and 4 colors of tables, one with wood grain and one without.

* Walls/roofs (from Everyday Town):
* Includes woven wall texture, plus two types of wall with wood trim.

Also includes :
* Basic interior design elements – fireplaces, windows, plants, stairs, etc
* Menu-ready icons included for all base item types, plus separate icons so you can make your own if you’d rather use another style of background

Magic Items: (in 7 colors or elements, a couple of items have variations instead of elements)
* 6 designs of books, 3 small, 3 large
* Scrolls
* Maps (one type burned)
* Fancy cards and playing cards
* 3 types of charms
* Quill, pen and brush
* Gems and generic sparkly items
* Keys in 3 styles
* Pocketwatches
* Mirrors
* Candles
* Lanterns
* Brooms
* Crystal balls
* Badge/brooches
* Statues and totems
* Fancy bottles, jars and other containers
* Jewelry box
* Mystery “?” box with ribbon
* Bows
* Crowns/tiaras
* Earrings
* Rings
* Necklaces
* Bracers
* Masks
* Glasses/goggles
* Robes, hats and clothing items
* Magic wands (3 styles)
* Plant growing from crystal seed
* Magic tea
* Spices and herbs
* Magic apples (gold and jeweled)
* Medallions


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
